purpose: Visual concept exploration only; no application changes.
prompts: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished, highly legible desktop web-app interface concept image for Ombuddi, a serious, calm case-recording tool used by ombuds. This is a design exploration, not a marketing landing page. Landscape 1536x1024 composition, flat front-on screen view, no laptop or desk props. Generous whitespace, strong readable charcoal typography, white work surface, muted warm gray surrounding workspace, restrained plum primary button and sage accents. A slim app header with text 'ombuddi' and small navigation 'Cases' 'People' 'Reports'. Show 'Cases / Add New Case'. Use only fictional example case name 'Cedar / River / Lantern'. Existing functionality to preserve: required Case Name plus Randomize action and small abstract landscape thumbnail used as case identifier; Description; description protection phrase control with Blank, Default Salt, Free text choices accessed by Change; IOA Codes multi-select; Organization Codes multi-select; Referral Sources multi-select with Other detail when selected; Cancel and Create case. No actual names or confidential contents. Under case name include legible helper 'Visible within your organization. Avoid sensitive details.' For security show 'Description protection: Default Salt' and 'Session default is set' with Change action; never claim the case title or all case metadata are encrypted. Selected IOA example may use '2E Communication'. Organization code example 'Workplace' is illustrative. Selected referral 'Unknown'. All text deliberate and legible. Make focusable/editable areas clear through visible labels, subtle underlines or very light surface distinction without excessive outlined boxes. No ornamental office props or huge icons. CONCEPT 1: PAPER ON A FOLDER. Draw one large white sheet on top of a pale warm manila folder with a modest folder tab that says 'New case', subtle convincing paper shadow, straight unrotated sheet, flat professional subtle tactile design. The folder and page fill the workspace but have substantial margins. At the top of the sheet place a small label Case Name and a large editable heading 'Cedar / River / Lantern' with thin underline, Randomize text action and small scene thumbnail near it. Helper underneath. Below: Description label followed by inviting large white writing space with gray placeholder 'Write a brief description…', then quiet security status row with Change. No individual description box. Referral Sources appear as compact labeled line 'Unknown' with 'Edit sources' action near page bottom. To the RIGHT of the white paper, on the visible folder margin, show two grouped sets of SMALL pasted pastel index flags. Group label IOA CODES, sage flag '2E Communication' with a little x, '+ Add IOA code' text action; below group label ORGANIZATION CODES, pale lavender flag 'Workplace' with x, '+ Add org code' text action. The flags are attached with tiny semi-transparent tape strips. Keep text horizontal, dark and readable. Avoid large decorative tape, avoid rotating flags. It must read as actual accessible clickable UI, not scrapbook art. Bottom of folder or aligned below paper: Cancel at left, Create case plum button at right. Outside app mockup along bottom in a narrow editorial caption band state '01 / The working folder' and small subtitle 'One writing surface. Small flags for classification.' Make this the most inviting of the concepts.

CONCEPT 2: QUIET SINGLE PAGE. Draw a notably different, precise editorial software design: one clean white continuous workspace with NO folder, NO cards, NO paper shadows, NO tape, NO boxed section containers. Narrow centered form column around 800 px wide, generous margins. Heading 'Add New Case' with supporting line 'Start with a name. Add the details you have.' At top: labeled Case Name, large editable text 'Cedar / River / Lantern' above thin bottom rule, Randomize as quiet text link, tiny scene thumbnail to right; helper underneath. Then label Description with quiet 'Optional' annotation, airy white blank writing area with placeholder 'Write a brief description…'. Quiet but clearly readable security status row under it, Change action. Beneath a generous gap and thin divider: heading 'Classification & referral'. Three compact list rows, NOT boxed cards: 'IOA Codes' paired with small sage selected chip '2E Communication' and 'Edit' action; 'Organization Codes' paired with small lavender chip 'Workplace' and Edit; 'Referral Sources' paired with 'Unknown' and Edit. The rows have generous vertical spacing with hairline rules and small chevrons. Make it evident these expand/open choosers. Bottom right plum Create case button, Cancel text action beside. Keep visual weight on name and description, secondary rows small but accessible, no tiny text. Outside app at bottom narrow editorial caption band: '02 / The quiet page' and subtitle 'Everything available. Fewer borders and competing shapes.'

CONCEPT 3: GUIDED FOCUS. Draw a distinctive calm multistep software flow on white, no folder, no tape, no cards. Use a slim left progress outline showing '1  Name & description' current and prominent, '2  Codes & referrals', '3  Review & create'; below a small muted 'Case preview' with miniature abstract landscape and 'Cedar / River / Lantern'. Large open central work area showing heading 'Start with the essentials' and subtitle 'Step 1 of 3'. Show current required Case Name underline text 'Cedar / River / Lantern', Randomize text action, helper. Show Description label and roomy open white typing area with placeholder 'Write a brief description…', security status and Change directly below. At bottom show Cancel and plum 'Continue' button. To communicate complete coverage, include in the left progress outline tiny descriptive secondary text under step 2 'IOA codes · Organization codes · Referral sources' and under step 3 'Check details before saving'. Outside the app at bottom in narrow editorial caption band say '03 / One decision group at a time' with subtitle 'Less to scan now. A clear review before creating the case.'
